verdict.rationale: GA4 can be driven entirely without its UI through its own first-party APIs. The Data API is documented for programmatic report access and for automating complex reporting tasks, with batch reports, filters and pagination. The Admin API automates reading and changing settings. Measurement Protocol sends server-to-server events. Official client libraries cover seven languages, and an official MCP server exists. Missing for 10: an official CLI, CI-specific guidance (e.g. non-interactive service-account auth in pipelines), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
